brief: Kestrel Offshore (fictional sample): dedicated offshore accounting staff for UK accounting and bookkeeping firms. Team based in Cebu, Philippines; UK office at 14 Park Row, Leeds LS1 5HN. Founded in 2017 by Martin Hale, a UK chartered accountant who ran a 12-person practice in Leeds and could not hire enough staff. He wrote the book The Capacity Plan. 120+ UK firms use Kestrel teams. 9 years working with UK practices. New staff train for 3 weeks in the Kestrel Academy before day one. Average time to a first team member: 5 weeks. Roles: offshore accountants, bookkeepers, payroll specialists, finance teams. Staff work UK office hours in the client's own software (Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, IRIS). Brand colour: crimson #B0122C, with deep red #7A0C1E for dark bands and the footer. Reviews: Priya Sandhu, Partner, Sandhu and Co Accountants: "Our Kestrel accountant had the month-end packs done before our own team got to them. Three months in, we took on eleven new clients without a single new UK hire." Tom Whitlock, Director, Whitlock Bookkeeping: "I expected to spend my evenings checking work. Instead our two bookkeepers follow our checklists to the letter and ask good questions when something looks off." Grace Ellery, Practice Manager, Ellery Tax: "Self assessment season used to mean weekends in the office. This January the team in Cebu handled the data entry and we signed off returns on time." Articles: How to add capacity without hiring locally (Offshoring, 2 September 2026); Five signs your practice has a capacity problem (Practice growth, 18 August 2026); Keeping control of quality with an offshore team (Quality, 4 August 2026). Contact: hello@kestrel-offshore.example.

head.title: Questions UK firms ask before they start

items.q: Is this the same as outsourcing?
items.a: No work leaves your firm's processes. Your team member works only for you, in your software, and reports to your managers. We employ them and look after HR and the office.

items.q: What hours does my team member work?
items.a: They work UK office hours, so they are online when your UK team is and can join your meetings and calls.

items.q: How long does it take to get started?
items.a: The average time to a first team member is 5 weeks, which includes 3 weeks of training in the Kestrel Academy.

items.q: Which software can the team use?
items.a: Our staff work in Xero, QuickBooks, Sage and IRIS, and learn any other systems your firm uses during onboarding.
Yes. We shortlist candidates who match the role, and you interview them and decide who joins your team.
